items.name: Try. Capture. Share. · Pop-up brief
items.text:
An independently authored fictional demo, not an official Meta event, commission or partnership. Dimensions and quantities are design assumptions, not measured capacity or safety validation.

Objective: Give first-time visitors in their twenties and thirties a 20-minute journey through trying on glasses, hands-free photography, open-ear listening and sharing with friends. Use the entire approximately 590 m² ground floor in Seongsu.

Program: One check-in counter; two four-seat fitting bars with mirrors; a photo walk with three photo spots; an eight-seat listening lounge; two semi-enclosed Messenger demo booths; one shared photo wall; one consultation and pickup counter.

Journey: Angled entrance → check-in → fitting bars → photo walk between columns → listening lounge → Messenger booths and photo wall in the annex → consultation and pickup. Keep the main route at least 1.5m clear. Use the south service door and storage for staff and stock.

Drawing: The north main hall is approximately 32 × 15m with a 4.2m assumed ceiling; the southeast annex is approximately 18 × 7m with a 3.6m assumed ceiling. Preserve the three 0.6m square columns. Keep the north shopfront and east windows visible. Ceiling heights are drawing assumptions; suspended loads are unreviewed. Do not furnish the toilets or storage.

Direction: Warm off-white surfaces, black lines inspired by acetate frames, and bright street-like lighting. Low walls, plants and signs create small Seongsu-inspired photo scenes.

Request: Design the entire floor with actual furniture and partitions, connecting the experiences with a one-way visitor journey.
items.notes: Authored fictional venue and brief. Muse performed the drawing reading and design; no operations or safety simulation is included.

content.title: Seongsu Pop-up · Ray-Ban Meta × Messenger · Planning Report

sections.text: A fictional concept using the entire ground floor of Seongsu Pop-up Studio. The north main hall is the experience zone with assumed 4.2m ceiling; the southeast annex is for sharing with assumed 3.6m ceiling. The approximately 588 m² floor uses polished concrete. This is a design exercise, not an official event.

First-time visitors in their twenties and thirties are invited to try, capture, listen and share within 20 minutes. Warm off-white surfaces, black lines and bright lighting suggest a lively street, with low walls, plants and photo spots creating moments along the walk. Feature walls include 'SEE WHAT YOU SEE' and 'Hey Meta, take a photo' on the north wall and the 'LIVE FROM YOUR EYES' video wall. This is a demo interpretation, not an official brand guide.

Angled entrance → check-in → fitting bars → photo walk → listening lounge → Messenger demo → shared photo wall → consultation and pickup. The main loop is planned 1.6m wide with 1.2m connectors, intended to stay 1.5m clear. Staff and stock use the south service door and storage. This is a planned route; widths and queue conflicts require on-site review.

Staffing follows check-in, fitting, photography, listening, demos, sharing and consultation. Staff and stock use the south service door, storage and southern operations area. Toilets and storage retain existing uses. Ceiling heights are drawing assumptions; truss and pendant loads have not been reviewed.

The three 0.6m square columns are retained. Tall walls are not planned in front of the north shopfront or east windows. Capacity, visibility and accessibility have not been certified. Wall and doorway dimensions and queue conflicts require measurement.

booths.description: Two semi-enclosed booths formed by four 2.39m walls support hands-free messaging demos. Hanging sign, spots, plinth and plant complete the west annex setting.
booths.circulation: Enter from the lounge via the annex and south connectors. Queue spacing and overlapping speech need on-site review.

booths.description: 3.2m shared photo wall with SHARE YOUR VIEW graphic and consultation/pickup counter complete the visit. Spots, plinths and plants frame the east annex setting.
booths.circulation: Continue through the annex after the Messenger demo via the south connector. Check that counter queues do not conflict with the south service route.

fee.basis: No fee estimate: area, duration and pricing basis have not been agreed.
fee.includes: Included equipment and operating services are to be agreed.

booths.description: Two sofa-table groups with audio display and information board provide eight-seat open-ear listening. Pendant cluster and hanging sign define the east-side lounge.
booths.circulation: Enter from the photo walk via the main loop and east aisles. Measure clearances around both sofa groups on site; flow is planned, not simulated.

fee.basis: No fee estimate: area, duration and pricing basis have not been agreed.
fee.includes: Included equipment and operating services are to be agreed.

booths.description: Two fitting bars with black backdrops, mirror panels, tables and chairs sit near the north shopfront. Overhead truss with spots supports try-on guidance.
booths.circulation: Enter after check-in via the north connector and main loop. Planned queues use the south aisles; confirm the intended 1.5m route stays clear.

fee.basis: No fee estimate: area, duration and pricing basis have not been agreed.
fee.includes: Included equipment and operating services are to be agreed.

booths.description: Central photo walk with three 2.4m backdrops, studio lights and phone stands for hands-free capture. Low 1.2m walls, plinths, plants and vitrine suggest Seongsu streets.
booths.circulation: Planned one-way route leads from fitting through the columns via the central connector. Spot queues are not simulated; verify conflicts during busy periods.

fee.basis: No fee estimate: area, duration and pricing basis have not been agreed.
fee.includes: Included equipment and operating services are to be agreed.

booths.description: Check-in counter, information board, glasses vitrine and oversized glasses sculpture introduce the 20-minute journey. Center vitrines, hanging sign and pendants mark the northeast entry zone.
booths.circulation: Enter directly from the angled doorway via the entry connector and planned entry queue. Verify entry queues leave the doorway clear; widths are planned, not simulated.
